title: 第21章 那道身影第22章 妖兽来袭
slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
第21章那道身影
江尘早已睡去。
这两日，江尘一直在南宫婉儿的房间睡觉，有了第一次，第二次就顺其自然的多，
虽然两人并未发生什么事情，但南宫婉儿却逐渐对江尘有意无意的肢体接触不再排斥。
只是今晚，南宫婉儿却久久未眠，
看着睡在自己身侧的江尘，她心中既甜蜜又苦涩，回忆起这段日子，就如同一场梦一样，今生的相见不过是为了斩断前世的姻缘，而现在终于要到梦醒的时候了，
她轻轻摩挲着江尘的脸颊，“你好好保重，就当我从来没有出现过。”
南宫婉儿缓缓起身，留恋的看了眼睡的正香的江尘，将曼妙娇躯掩在衣裙内，小心的打开房门，悄然离去。
江尘望着那道倩影消失在夜色中，他两世为人，自然看出这个化名宫婉的女人绝非像她表现出的那么简单，可谁又没有秘密呢，
他不知道两人究竟是什么关系，或许一别后，再无相见之日。
夜幕之下，
天武城街道已没有了行人，
街道上一片寂静，落针可闻，
月明星稀，
月光透过树叶照在南宫婉儿的脸上，显出斑驳光影，
南宫婉儿体内依旧残存着月华之力，纵使经过了一个月的修养，依旧没有痊愈，更何况在人族城中，魔力发动难免节外生枝，
她走的并不快，半个时辰还未走出天武城。
在某个狭窄街口的时候，她突然停下了脚步，
一道淡淡血腥味传来，
南宫婉儿眼神一凝，一股莫名气势发出，

或是因为伤势未愈，原本的灵觉此时也失去了作用，并未有任何发现。
难道是自己的错觉？
下一刻，
一声凄厉惨叫在相隔不远的街道传来，
在寂静的夜空中显得格外刺耳，
呼啦啦~
紧接着传来一道怪异声响，似有什么东西在上空飞过，
南宫婉儿颦着娥眉，神色有些凝重，
妖兽！
若是曾经，这种级别的妖兽她挥手便能灭杀，
可如今，
她犹豫半晌，最终还是继续前进。
血腥味，越来越浓了...
“啊！
！”
又一声尖叫传来，
继而引动了整个天武城！
content_en:
Chapter 21 That figure
Jiang Chen had already fallen asleep.
For the past two days, Jiang Chen has been sleeping in Nangong Wan'er's room. After the first time, it was much more natural the second time.
Although nothing happened between the two of them, Nangong Wan'er gradually no longer rejected Jiang Chen's intentional or unintentional physical contact.
But tonight, Nangong Wan'er didn't sleep for a long time.
Looking at Jiang Chen sleeping beside her, her heart was filled with sweetness and bitterness. Recalling these days, it was like a dream. The meeting in this life was just to break off the marriage in the previous life, and now it was finally time to wake up from the dream.
She gently stroked Jiang Chen's cheek and said, "Take care of yourself and pretend that I have never appeared."
Nangong Wan'er stood up slowly, glanced at Jiang Chen who was sleeping soundly with nostalgia, hid her graceful body in her dress, opened the door carefully, and left quietly.
Jiang Chen watched the beautiful figure disappear into the night. He had lived in two lifetimes, so he naturally realized that this woman whose pseudonym was Gong Wan was not as simple as she appeared. But who didn't have secrets?
He didn't know what the relationship between the two was. Maybe they would never see each other again after parting ways.
Under the night,
There are no pedestrians on the streets of Tianwucheng anymore.
There was silence on the street, you could hear the drop of a needle,
The moon and stars are sparse,
The moonlight shines through the leaves on Nangong Wan'er's face, showing mottled light and shadow.
The power of the moonlight still remains in Nangong Wan'er's body. Even after a month of cultivation, she still has not recovered. What's more, in a human city, the activation of magic power will inevitably cause unintended consequences.
She didn't walk very fast, and she hadn't left Tianwu City for half an hour.
At a certain narrow street intersection, she suddenly stopped.
A faint smell of blood came,
Nangong Wan'er's eyes condensed, and an inexplicable aura came out,
Perhaps because the injury has not healed, the original spiritual sense has lost its effect at this time, and no discovery has been made.
Is it my own illusion?
The next moment,
A shrill scream came from a street not far away,
It seemed particularly harsh in the silent night sky,
Hula~
Then there was a strange sound, as if something was flying above.
Nangong Wan'er frowned, her expression a little solemn,
Monster!
If she had ever been able to kill a monster of this level with a wave of her hand,
But now,
She hesitated for a while, then finally moved on.
The smell of blood is getting stronger and stronger...
"Ah!
! "
Another scream came,
Then it triggered the entire Tianwu City!
